$comment: Known Kong Admin API limits and prerequisites pinned by live tests, keyed by '<METHOD> <normalized-template>' and rendered in docs/endpoints.md.

notes.PUT /upstreams/{}/targets/{}: Kong does not create missing targets (answers 404) and merges omitted fields like PATCH.
notes.PUT /keys/{}: Kong answers 500 when called by name; works by id.
notes.PUT /key-sets/{}: Kong answers 500 when called by name; works by id.
notes.PUT /key-sets/{}/keys/{}: Kong answers 500 when called by key name; works by key id.
notes.GET /status/dns: Answers 501 when Kong uses the legacy DNS client.
notes.GET /config: DB-less mode only (answers 400 in database mode).
notes.POST /config: DB-less mode only (answers 400 in database mode).
notes.GET /clustering/data-planes: Hybrid-mode Control Plane only (answers 400 in traditional mode).
notes.GET /clustering/status: Hybrid-mode Control Plane only (answers 400 in traditional mode).
notes.POST /acme: Requires the `acme` plugin configured and a reachable HTTP-01 challenge domain.
